Information received since the February meeting points to continued labor-market strengthening and moderate growth; the 25 bp increase to a 0.75–1.00% funds-rate range, with ongoing balance-sheet reinvestment, reflects a gradual, Taylor-rule-type normalization (Clarida, Galí, and Gertler) implemented via IOER and forward guidance (Goodfriend; Svensson and Woodford). With market-based inflation compensation still low and the “symmetric” 2% objective emphasized, the Committee signals anchored expectations and interest-rate smoothing, leaving policy modestly accommodative even as it turns slightly more hawkish.
